sersic_mag + band suffix → gf_mag. Stored total single-Sersic apparent magnitude; the source configuration uses a photometric zeropoint of 30. No additional extinction, redshift or K correction is applied here.

sersic_reff_arcsec + band suffix → gf_re_arcsec. Stored semi-major-axis effective (half-model-light) radius. The producer converts fitted pixels to arcsec; this analysis does not substitute it for R_P.
sersic_reff_pixels + band suffix → gf_re_pixels. Stored fitted semi-major-axis effective radius in pixels.
sersic_mean_mue + band suffix → gf_mu_mean. Stored mean surface brightness inside the effective ellipse; fainter corresponds to larger numbers. Equals m+2.5 log10(2 pi q R_e^2) for the model.
sersic_mue + band suffix → gf_mu_e. Stored Sersic surface brightness at R_e, distinct from the mean inside R_e.
sersic_n + band suffix → gf_n. Sersic shape index; shared across bands in this GALFITM configuration, constrained to 0.2–5.
sersic_q + band suffix → gf_q. Model minor/major axis ratio; shared across bands, constrained to 0.3–1.
sersic_chi2red + band suffix → gf_chi2red. Stored CHI2NU/reduced chi-square from the fitter; not recomputed using exported NDOF.
